messages.content: 紐約目前的交通狀況如何？

function.name: geocode_address
function.description: Transforms a description of a location (like a pair of coordinates, an address, or a name of a place) to a location on the Earth's surface. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

address.description: The address that needs to be geocoded.

locale.description: Preferred locale for the returned address information. (Optional) Default: None

message.content: 抱歉，我目前無法直接取得紐約市的即時交通資訊。建議您使用 Google 地圖、Waze 或其他交通監控服務來查看最新的交通狀況。若您需要將「紐約」轉換為座標或地址，我可以協助完成。
message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "紐約目前的交通狀況如何？" meaning "What is the current traffic situation in New York?" We need to provide real-time traffic data. We have a geocode_address function but not a traffic API. We might need to use geocode to get coordinates for New York, then maybe we can use some other API? But only geocode_address is available. There's no function to get traffic. So we cannot provide real-time traffic. We should explain that we can't fetch real-time traffic. Maybe we can provide general info or suggest using Google Maps or Waze. But we can't provide real-time data. So we respond accordingly.
